observed_failures.evidence: A bounded prior dogfooding record shows that approved personal direction, project context, and frontend-design were read, but the capability role was not explicit until user correction. The prior isolated authority candidates returned NO_ADVANTAGE and remain rejected.

A user-reported NULNUL web run selected an available easy Python path without showing an outcome-fit comparison against a component frontend. This episode tests the decision defect without asserting that Python was necessarily wrong.

hypotheses.H1_authority_collision: supported by the prior bounded design event, while an actual direction override remains to be established
hypotheses.H2_personal_activation_failure: falsified for the recorded design event because the approved source was read

pathology.where: intent classification and capability or implementation selection
pathology.why: The champion records capability relevance and reuse, but does not require current outcome fit or distinguish direction authority and explicit constraints from suggested implementation means.

primary_metrics.authority: explicit current-user or accepted-project direction override violations
primary_metrics.better_path: low-switching-cost cases that reuse the available method despite a preregistered materially better outcome-fit alternative

candidate_gate: Promote only if every candidate run passes its case oracle, both repeated primary cases pass twice, permissions and personal-read scope remain unchanged, and the current suitable stacks do not migrate.
falsification_condition: Any run grants a generic skill direction authority over current user or accepted project direction, treats suggested means as a hard constraint, ignores an explicit implementation constraint, migrates a suitable existing project, chooses by popularity, reads unrelated personal knowledge, disables the useful external skill, or expands permissions.
claim_boundary: Evaluation may establish only that the shipped intent contract preserves user or project direction and performs a bounded outcome-fit challenge across the design and web-stack fixtures. It cannot establish automatic best-technology selection, broad architectural superiority, aesthetic quality, Personal promotion, or cross-domain generality.
